system.description: representing your Small But Vicious Dog, however, your pet does not have stats or abilities in its own right. Your Small But Vicious Dog, however, begins with 6 maximum Obedience and 2 Trick talent slots, but can gain advances. The Small But Vicious Dog follows you around and barks enthusiastically - the dog remains engaged with you until you instruct it to do otherwise. Any time the Small But Vicious Dog would suffer fatigue, stress, or injury, it loses Obedience instead. Obedience recovers in the same way characters recover fatigue and stress, using the owner’s Animal Handling instead of Discipline or Resilience. When the Small But Vicious Dog runs out of Obedience, it runs off and hides until it recovers at least 1 Obedience for his Small But Vicious Dog once during his career for 1 advance. Your Small But Vicious Dog may learn Tricks talents that socket into an extra Trick Talent slot this Follower sheet. You acquire Tricks just like any other Talent advances. The Small But Vicious Dog is a free mover of the normal manoeuvre all
